# Export

**Short:** Converting a ``.nsys-rep`` into a structured, queryable format (SQLite, Parquet / Arrow directories, single-file Arrow, HDF5, JSON Lines, text). Done with ``nsys export`` or auto-generated by analysis commands.

**Details:**

- The default format is **SQLite** — a single-file relational DB, best for ad-hoc SQL and one-off lookups. ``nsys stats``, ``nsys analyze``, and ``nsys recipe`` auto-generate a SQLite export next to the ``.nsys-rep`` if one isn't already present (force a re-export with ``--force-export``).
- **Parquet directory** (``parquetdir``) and **Arrow directory** (``arrowdir``) produce one file per event table — best for columnar pipelines (pandas, Polars, DuckDB).
- Other formats: **HDF5**, **JSON Lines**, single-file **Arrow**, **text**, **info** — used for specific integrations.
- The export is laid out as one table per event source. Almost every text column is an integer ID into a central ``StringIds`` table — joins are needed to resolve names.
- Useful options on ``nsys export``: ``--tables`` (regex filter), ``--times`` (time-range filter), ``--ts-normalize`` / ``--ts-shift`` (align distributed runs), ``--include-blobs`` (NVTX payload binaries), ``--lazy=false`` (emit empty tables too).
